Name: axi_resp_i.ar_ready
Structural Path: axi_resp_i.ar_ready -> read-address handshake -> adapter FSM progress -> valid_o
Attack Scenarios: Blocking or corrupting axi_resp_i.ar_ready during an applicable AXI transaction stalls adapter progress or suppresses valid_o service.
Justification: Holding read-address readiness in the wrong state prevents request progress and caused complete service failure.

Justification: Corruption prevents write-address acceptance across applicable write/AMO paths and fully suppresses service.
